findings.message: Bare `except:` with `pass` swallows all exceptions (including GatewayError and unexpected errors) instead of converting them to PaymentError; callers expecting PaymentError will no longer receive it. Worse, if charge() raises, `result` is never assigned, so the following `return result` raises UnboundLocalError/NameError rather than a meaningful error.
findings.suggestion: Restore typed handling, e.g. `except GatewayError as exc: raise PaymentError(f"charge failed for order {order.id}: {exc}") from exc` (and do not return an unassigned result on failure).
